content: Dcm can directly access SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement s or NvDataInterface . nvData s in AbstractRequiredPortPro- totype s An exception to the rule described in [constr_2019] applies: the Dcm can di- rectly access SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement s or NvDataInterface . nvData s in AbstractRequiredPortPrototype s as long as [constr_1071] is ful- filled. For this purpose, the ServiceSwComponentType that represents the Dcm functional- ity can have AbstractProvidedPortPrototype s typed by a compatible Sender- ReceiverInterface that may set attribute isService to false .
